newOpenItem.title: Surface-format mechanism steps and retained clinical catalogue claims

review.rationale: The named owner fields and dosing contradiction are corrected. Shared mechanism-step templates still turn recognition and delivery into completed killing and bystander activity without product-specific qualifications; audit their actual users individually. A product-path label retains an unsupported global superiority claim; changing that product label follows the existing owner-approval rule. Other retained clinical catalogue, worldwide-first, access and toxicity claims outside the adopted scope are not newly certified.

sourceOwnerVisualItems.finding: Inline pale node fills retain pale theme text: highlighted routing nodes and three strategy-category nodes have poor contrast in this renderer. Live Guide theme behavior was not tested.
Arrows sort proposals by a teaching framework. They do not prove exclusive failure classes, causally effective redesigns, or that only bispecific binding changes delivery.
